# The --table of tools/cts/glmark2-mali-e2e-selftest.sh, in the form of
# tools/cts/glmark2-pictures.txt: a 'mali' column of three scenes, so the
# drafts do not move when the real table gains its 'mali' column. Scene 1 is
# the fake program's picture (a match), scene 2 is off in probe c and the mean
# (a mismatch), scene 5 is not black where the fault's picture is not either
# (a match); the other 30 have no reference.
tolerance 8
mali | [build] use-vbo=false | 800x600; probes c 336699ff, tl 000000ff, tr 000000ff, bl 000000ff, br 000000ff; crc16 1a2b, crc16q 3c4d; mean 51 102 153; black no
mali | [build] use-vbo=true | 800x600; probes c 996633ff, tl 000000ff, tr 000000ff, bl 000000ff, br 000000ff; crc16 5e6f, crc16q 7a8b; mean 153 102 51; black no
mali | [texture] texture-filter=mipmap | 800x600; probes c 33669aff, tl 000000ff, tr 000000ff, bl 000000ff, br 000000ff; crc16 0f0f, crc16q 3c4d; mean 50 101 152; black no
